intent: Sum available_today_quantity across all Graz PowerTool stores (including zero-availability) for the Festool SYS 3JJ-9LM tool-bag variant and report as '%d total'.

params.family: Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag

success_criteria: Resolve exactly one product variant in family 'Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag', brand Festool, with storage_type property = 'tool bag'
Aggregate available_today_quantity over every store with city='Graz', left-joined so 0-availability/missing-inventory branches are still counted
refs include the product record path and every Graz store record path

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family AND pv.product_kind_id = :kind AND pvp.property_key = 'storage_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :storage_type;

WITH target AS (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family AND pv.product_kind_id = :kind AND pvp.property_key = 'storage_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :storage_type) SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = (SELECT product_sku FROM target) WHERE s.city = :city ORDER BY s.store_id;

WITH target AS (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family AND pv.product_kind_id = :kind AND pvp.property_key = 'storage_type' AND pvp.property_value_text = :storage_type) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0)), 0) AS total FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = (SELECT product_sku FROM target) WHERE s.city = :city;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
